**Caption:**

SpaceX acquired xAI. Most people scrolled past this.

Here's why it's one of the biggest tech announcements of the decade: orbital solar gives you unlimited clean energy with no weather, no night cycle, and no grid — and AI inference running from orbit means compute that's energy-abundant and geographically unrestricted. SpaceX has the rockets and Starlink's backbone. xAI has the models. Nobody else on Earth has both.
